video.prompt:
[SCENE] Late autumn morning at a clear Japanese mountain stream, vertical 9:16 frame. Close shot at water level: crystal-clear shallow water flows over smooth grey river stones, a few red and orange maple leaves drift on the surface, faint mist rises from the water. A bare adult hand in a plain dark sleeve with no markings reaches in from the top of the frame, dips the fingertips into the water, then quickly pulls back with a small flinch, drops of water falling from the fingers.
[CAMERA] Static low angle just above the water surface, 50mm lens, aperture f/5.6 so the stones and leaves stay clearly readable (no heavy background blur), focus on the hand and water. Real-time speed, no slow-motion.
[LIGHTING] Cool soft morning light, 6000K, low sun breaking through trees from camera-right, gentle glints on the ripples, slightly hazy air.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Glassy cold clear water, wet smooth granite stones, crisp fallen maple leaves, natural skin with fine water droplets.
[COLOR PALETTE] Cold blue-green water, slate grey stones, small accents of crimson and amber leaves. Natural contrast.
[AUDIO] Natural sounds only: stream murmur, a small splash, distant birds. No music, no voice.
[AVOID] Logos, text, letters, brand marks, waders, boots, fishing gear, products, people's faces, extra fingers, deformed hands, morphing, camera shake, fisheye distortion, heavy bokeh, snow, ice.
